title: RequestInstantDraftCallableResponse
description: Callable response returned by requestInstantDraft. building: Supply Intake is reading the link; poll getInstantDraft after pollAfterMs. staff_follow_up: Catch cannot build this draft by itself yet, so a person follows up on WhatsApp. Either way the draft page link is /drafts/{draftId} with the website's token in its fragment, and nothing is published before the submitter claims it.

support.description: instant: a platform Supply Intake reads with its own adapter. best_effort: any other public page, read only where robots.txt allows and only if it carries event markup. staff_follow_up: a link Catch does not read by itself.
